D.t: Juliana Stratton leads by 26.0 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 1,207,749 votes; a one point swing is about 23,253 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +16.8 and D +34.6. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
The polls page average is D +12.5. Your best recent poll is ActiVote at D +17.0; your worst is Public Policy Polling for Chicago News Weekly (D) at D +12.1. 2 polls in the last 30 days.

D.t: Against the 2024 presidential vote, Juliana Stratton runs furthest behind in McLean, Sangamon, Winnebago. That is where the forecast sees voters who backed your side two years ago and have not come back yet.

$1.1M cash against $1.5M. Outspent: lean on earned media, digital, field and the outside groups, and pick the two or three media markets that decide it.
